title: Lightning Cast
description: Simple datapack to cast lightning where you look.
body:
# Lightning Cast Datapack

A simple datapack that introduces Lightning Stick item to summon lightning at where you look with right-click.

## How to Install

1. Download and move zip file into your world save e.g `.minecraft\saves\yourworld\datapacks\` or new world

2. For new world, you may have to enable the datapack with `/datapack enable`

## How to obtain Lightning Stick

a. Use `/function lightning_cast:stick` command

OR

b. Craft with blaze rod and nether star
